note: One row per component in the UI SDK Component Behavior Inventory (Notion, 55 pages). `id` is the canonical name an agent uses and matches shadcn/ui's PascalCase export where one exists. `inventory` is the page title in the Notion inventory. `shadcn` is the file name under shadcn/ui's radix base, or null when shadcn ships nothing for it. `registry` is the Vois registry item that already themes it, or null. Checked against shadcn-ui/ui at commit 055aa6b (2026-11-23) and registry/registry.json (37 items). `card` names the component's behavior card (behaviors/<card>.json) where one exists.

statuses.have: A vois-* registry item already exists.
statuses.covered: No item of its own: another vois-* item does the job. `coveredBy` names it.
statuses.build: shadcn ships it and the registry has no item yet. Pull the shadcn source and theme it with Vois tokens.
statuses.compose: shadcn ships no single component. Build it from other registry items once those exist. `composedFrom` names them.
statuses.defer: shadcn ships nothing and the pattern is real. Write the behavior card now, build the component later.
statuses.skip: Not a UI control for this registry, or no shadcn source and no use in the skills. Behaviors stay in Notion.

ruleScopes.note: vois-tokens rule categories that apply to particular components. vois-components/scripts/retrieval.mjs puts these rules in those components' packets. Every other category is cross-cutting and stays out of packets. Components may come from names or outsideInventory.

outsideInventory.note: Names the vois-components Quick Reference uses that have a shadcn source and no registry item. They are not in the Notion inventory, so they get no behavior card yet. Listed so the gap is visible.
